In single-exposure OLS with region indicators, all ten candidates were non-significant (smallest p ≈ 0.12 for soil_moisture, leaf_litter, and slope_deg); a full multivariable model likewise showed no significant exposure, and results were stable under HC3 robust SEs, robust regression, and outlier removal. soil_moisture was the most consistent candidate (positive coefficient, largest standardized effect), so it was chosen for the single confirmatory test. The pre-registered confirmatory OLS on held-out data returned estimate = -0.134, SE = 0.114, p = 0.241 (n = 396), which is not significant at alpha = 0.05. The effect is therefore not confirmed.
